He says, in a perfectly steady voice, that you took your time, and you sit down opposite him, and neither of you says anything for the better part of an hour. It is the quietest, kindest return that a man could have had, and it is the only one that you will ever wish to remember.

variants.headline: A MAN WHO HAD ALREADY COME HOME ONCE
variants.text: You came home once before, in the dark, in a closed cab, to sit beside a friend in a silent room. Nobody knows it but the two of you. When you walk into Baker Street in the April of 1894, in plain daylight, Watson takes your hand and says only that it was a very long time between visits. You say that it was. You do not say that you would have come sooner, if you had been able. He knows.

variants.headline: THE LETTER FROM FLORENCE
variants.text: Watson has the letter still. He has kept it in his pocket-book for three years, with the creases worn white, and he takes it out on the first evening, and lays it on the table between you without a word. It is four lines long. 'I had it by heart,' he says, 'in a week. I only kept it to be sure that I had not made it up.' You do not trust your voice. You pour the whisky.

variants.headline: A SUPPER FOR TWO, LAID BY A BROTHER
variants.text: Mycroft is in the sitting-room when you arrive, in your chair, with a cold supper laid for two and the air of a man who has been there since noon. 'You are late,' he says. 'I have paid your bank for three years, and I do not propose to be thanked.' He is, for the first time in your memory, extremely moved, and he conceals it by eating a chicken leg.

ENDING_HER_MAJESTYS_SERVICE.title: In Her Majesty's Service
ENDING_HER_MAJESTYS_SERVICE.headline: PROFESSOR MORIARTY: A QUIET END. THE NAPOLEON OF CRIME IS NO MORE
ENDING_HER_MAJESTYS_SERVICE.text: There is no trial, no headline, no inquest. A closed carriage, a closed court, and a closed file, and by Whitsun the Professor's organisation has ceased to exist, quite as though it had never been. You are given a small office in a street off Whitehall, with a name on the door that is not your own, and a salary that is paid by a department that does not appear in the Estimates. It is interesting work. It is not, you reflect, the kind of work that one boasts of, even to Watson, who is told only that you are engaged on 'a matter for a friend in the Government'. You keep the commission in a drawer, and you do not read it.

variants.headline: A HAND ON THE LEVER
variants.text: You hold, in a small black pocket-book, the signature of an Under-Secretary of State, and it is a thing that you will use very seldom, and never lightly. It makes you a good servant to the Crown, since a man who owns a minister is a man who need never be ignored. You are very good at it. You tell yourself that you will not become what you have caught. It is a thing that is easy to say in the first year.

variants.headline: A SERVANT WHO WOULD NOT READ
variants.text: You serve the Crown, and you have never opened the black book, and the Crown, to its surprise, rather likes it. 'A man who has not read it,' says Mycroft, 'cannot be asked what is in it.' It is a very sound principle. It lets you sleep. It is also the one thing about the whole affair that you have never been able to look at straight.

ENDING_THE_SECOND_LEDGER.title: The Second Ledger
ENDING_THE_SECOND_LEDGER.headline: THE GREAT SCANDAL: ELEVEN COLUMNS IN THE STANDARD; THREE MEMBERS RESIGN
ENDING_THE_SECOND_LEDGER.text: It is called, within a week, the Moriarty Scandal, and it runs for the whole of the summer. Three Members of Parliament resign. A bishop goes abroad. A Cabinet Minister makes a speech of three hours, and is not believed. At the end of it there is a Royal Commission, and a Bill, and a very great quantity of ink. The Professor's name is spoken in the House with a kind of reluctant awe. Mycroft does not speak to you for the whole of the autumn, and then, one evening in November, he calls in a hansom without a number and says only that he has come to say that you were right, and that he cannot bear it.

variants.headline: A MINISTER WHO SPOKE FIRST
variants.text: Lord Harcastle is the only man in the book who has already confessed, and the only one who is not ruined. He gives evidence to the Commission in a low, level voice and is spared by an act of the House. It is a very curious thing. You are, you find, glad for him, and a little ashamed of being so, and the two feelings sit side by side at your table for the rest of the year.
